name: Frost Lunge

Style: same highly detailed dark fantasy painted realism as references, tangible chipped steel, worn bronze, turbulent atmospheric scenery, controlled magical glow, rich deep shadows and sharp focal accents. Portrait 2:3, 1024x1536. Focal subject in lower-middle 45-85 percent vertical region, generous richly painted background above and to either side for user crop adjustments. Complete continuous edge-to-edge artwork. No card frame, text, letters, symbols resembling writing, UI, logos, borders, watermark or collage. No gore. Strong clear silhouette readable at card size.
